description: Request body for creating (resolve-or-create) or renaming a public channel.

description.description: Short summary of what the channel is for, shown in its empty area and searchable. Applies only when this call creates the channel.

name.description: Channel name, rendered as #<name>. Normalized to lowercase-dashed.

star.description: Star the channel for the requester when this call creates it. Ignored when the channel already exists, which leaves existing stars untouched.
